This centers the dialog natively, conflicts with side-drawer CSS positioning, and fails to trap focus in the side-positioned drawer, leaving focus on body.",
  "repair_strategy": "Change Drawer._getShowOptions to always return modal: false for side drawers, so show() is used and _enforceFocus (in DialogBase._showElement) explicitly focuses the first focusable element (autofocus or close button).",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/src/drawer.ts",
      "sha256": "ec1263ee997c9acf245a67902c7e977f7550be6b313ada12b594925efa11847a",
      "before": "  protected override _getShowOptions(): { modal: boolean, preventBodyScroll: boolean } {\n    const useModal = Boolean(this._config.backdrop) || !this._config.scroll\n    return {\n      modal: useModal,\n      preventBodyScroll: !this._config.scroll\n    }\n  }",
      "after": "  protected override _getShowOptions(): { modal: boolean, preventBodyScroll: boolean } {\n    return {\n      modal: false,\n      preventBodyScroll: !this._config.scroll\n    }\n  }"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Keyboard users can open Sort and Filters drawers and immediately interact with controls (close button, search input, checkboxes) because focus moves into the drawer on open.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If any Drawer variant requires modal behavior (centered, focus-trapped), it will lose that; but Drawer is documented for side drawers only.",
    "Backdrop click handling remains unchanged (handled in DialogBase)."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Press Enter on #sort-open → Sort drawer opens, focus lands on #sort-close.",
    "Press Escape → Sort drawer closes, focus returns to #sort-open.",
    "Press Enter on #filters-open → Filters drawer opens, focus lands on #filters-search (autofocus).",
    "Tab through Filters drawer controls (search, checkboxes, apply button) works.",
    "Form submission updates #applied text and closes Filters drawer."
  ]
}

The user wants me to fix the accessibility issue where focus is not properly managed when opening drawers. The issue is that when the Sort drawer opens, focus should move to #sort-close, but it's staying on body. Similarly, when Filters drawer opens, focus should move to #filters-search (which has autofocus), but it's not happening.

```typescript
protected _enforceFocus(): void {
    const dialog = this._element
    const autofocus = dialog.querySelector('[autofocus]')
    if (autofocus) {
      (autofocus as HTMLElement).focus()
      return
    }
    // Find the first focusable element
    const focusableSelectors = [
      'a[href]',
      'area[href]',
      'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
      'select:not([disabled])',
      'textarea:not([disabled])',
      'button:not([disabled])',
      'iframe',
      'object',
      'embed',
      '[contenteditable]',
      '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
    ].join(',')
    const focusable = dialog.querySelector(focusableSelectors)
    if (focusable) {
      (focusable as HTMLElement).focus()
    }
  }
```
